dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.

I love getting pets and - you guessed it - snuggles!

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!

My #BoroughBreak Buddy Writes: Butterburr ... what a charming boy and cuddle bug! 🥰
This adorable sweetheart is the definition of a cuddle bug! Butterburr was an absolute gentleman during our time together. He walked beautifully by my side, easily refocused when distracted, hardly barked, and had very little leash pulling. He is such a loving, trusting baby doll who simply wants a safe, quiet home where he can relax and nap on the couch.
We spent time snuggling on the couch, and before long, Butterburr was fast asleep right on top of me, complete with the cutest little snores! He never wanted to leave my side and kept rolling over for belly rubs. ❤️
Butterburr is a true sweetheart who deserves a cozy couch, a loving family, and a peaceful place to call home. He has so much love to give and would make the most wonderful companion. Let's get this precious boy out of the kennel and into the loving home he deserves! 🏡💕
dog.name: Butterburr
